items.claim: 'Ok resume witht eh 12 subagents! don't stop until finsihed!' then 'From now on spawn 25 subagents'

items.claim: Readers sometimes end with no output or ask questions
items.fact: Batches with ~33+ large items often fail (no final output, or reader stops asking for confirmation); fix is to split the batch in half (C145a/b), requeue; readers admitting from-memory line numbers get an Opus check. Reader ACCEPT only means checker passed (lines exist, names appear), not truth. Also stale 'running' states must be cleared after aborts.
